description: Validate a JSON document, or up to 1000 of them, against a JSON Schema (draft 7, 2019-09 or 2020-12) and list every error with its path. Cost: 1 credit per call. Output: JSON. {valid, errors: [{index, path, message, validator}], count}; meta: {draft, instances, truncated?}

draft.description: JSON Schema draft. auto follows the schema's $schema and defaults to 2020-12.

instance.description: One JSON value to validate (any type, including null). Use this or instances.

instances.description: Up to 1000 JSON values validated against the same schema. Use this or instance.

schema.description: The JSON Schema to validate against.

name: json_schema_validate
title: JSON Schema validator
